duration.text: The Long term Chinese program at Dongguan University of Technology is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1） Application form2）A copy of the passport(page with photo)3）Passport Homepage and Visa page (If in China)

requirements.text: 1.Non-Chinese citizens holding valid foreign ordinary passports2.Physical Condition and Medical ExaminationIn good health, meets the health examination standards of applying for a student visa or residence permit in China.Freshmen shoud are required to Medical examination in Guangdong International Travel Health Care Center will be arranged for freshmen after registration. Unqualified students will be rejected. 3. Age Requirement 18-50 years old4. Other RequirementsThe applicant should be friendly to China, honest, law-abiding, respects the customs of Chinese people and has no record of violating university rules, public security punishment or criminal record.
